effect_description_eng:
While you don't have [Pawn Device], you may ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・By trashing 1 of your non-red option cards in the battle area, gain 1 memory.
inherited_effect_description_eng: Security Effect [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 11000 DP or less. Then, add this card to the hand.
